content: जाठर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [जठरे भवः अण्] Belonging to or being in the stomach, stomachic, abdominal; धनक्षये वर्धति जाठराग्निः <ls>Pt. 2. 178</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 The digestive faculty, gastric fluid. .²2 ‘Offspring of the womb’, a child; भविष्यतस्तवाभद्रावभद्रे जाठराधमौ <ls>Bhāg. 3. 14. 38</ls>.
